text: Mummy's last vitamin D was 33.9 ng/mL (CarePlus Path Lab, 14-Oct-2025).
सबसे हाल की रिपोर्ट (14-Oct-2025) के अनुसार Mummy का Vitamin D (25-OH) 33.9 ng/mL था।

Mummy's vitamin D is going up. The first report (08-Mar-2025) was 33.7 nmol/L; the second (17-Jun-2025) was 18.9 ng/mL, which is about 47.3 nmol/L; and the latest (14-Oct-2025) was 33.9 ng/mL, about 84.8 nmol/L. So levels have increased over time.
The reports provided do not include any HbA1c test result.
Thyronorm 50 (levothyroxine) is used as replacement therapy in hypothyroidism.

No, based on these reports Mummy should not stop Thyronorm 50. Her TSH was high before treatment (9.24 on 08-Mar-2025, then 5.82 on 17-Jun-2025) and has normalised to 2.86 on 14-Oct-2025 while taking Thyronorm 50. Stopping levothyroxine could cause TSH to rise again. She should continue the medicine and discuss any dose changes with her doctor.

They show that TSH and FT4 levels improved and are within/near normal range after starting levothyroxine, but whether to stop the medication is a clinical decision that is not addressed in the provided reports.
Bhaiya's last uric acid was 333 µmol/L (approximately 5.6 mg/dL) on 25.08.2024.
पिछला uric acid 12/04/2024 की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार 9.2 mg/dL था।

Bhaiya's uric acid went up slightly from 8.9 mg/dL on 2024-02-10 to 9.2 mg/dL on 2024-04-12, then came down to about 5.6 mg/dL by 2024-08-25 (333 µmol/L). Overall, it is down after starting allopurinol.
No HbA1c result is present in the provided reports.

Zyloric 100 (allopurinol) is used for managing adults with signs and symptoms of primary or secondary gout (acute attacks, tophi, joint destruction, uric acid lithiasis, and/or nephropathy); managing adult and pediatric patients with leukemia, lymphoma and solid tumor malignancies receiving cancer therapy that causes elevated serum and urinary uric acid levels; and managing adult patients with recurrent calcium oxalate calculi whose daily uric acid excretion exceeds 800 mg/day in males and 750 mg/day in females despite lifestyle changes. It is not recommended for asymptomatic hyperuricemia.

The reports do not state whether Bhaiya should stop taking Zyloric 100. They do show that uric acid was high before starting allopurinol and later within normal range, but stopping or continuing medication requires a doctor's advice.
